title.en: Ethernet's shortest frame: CSMA/CD at 1 Gbps over 1 km
title.zh: 以太网的最短帧：1 Gbps、1 公里的 CSMA/CD

description.en: Why a CSMA/CD frame must last at least twice the cable's propagation time, the minimum frame for a gigabit network, and what that means for classic and switched Ethernet.
description.zh: 为什么 CSMA/CD 的帧至少要持续电缆传播时间的两倍，千兆网络的最小帧长，以及这对经典以太网和交换式以太网意味着什么。

name.en: Minimum frame size of classic Ethernet
name.zh: 经典以太网的最小帧长 (classic Ethernet minimum frame size)

name.en: Ethernet frame format and MAC protocol: CSMA/CD, BEB
name.zh: 以太网帧格式与 MAC 协议 (Ethernet frame, CSMA/CD, BEB)
以太网的信道效率 (channel efficiency)

description.zh: 用单程传播时间 τ，而不是往返的 2τ

title.en: A practice problem, in the style of the exam
title.zh: 练习题 · 仿考试题型

paras.en: Consider building a CSMA/CD network running at 1 Gbps over a 1 km cable with no repeaters. The signal speed in the cable is 200,000 km/sec. What is the minimum frame size?
paras.zh: 设想建一个运行在 1 Gbps、电缆长 1 公里、没有中继器的 CSMA/CD 网络。信号在电缆中的速度是 200,000 公里/秒。最小帧长是多少？

items.en: **CSMA/CD**: classic Ethernet's way of sharing one cable. Listen before sending; while sending, keep listening, and stop at once if a collision is heard (collision detection).
items.zh: **CSMA/CD**：经典以太网共用一根电缆的办法。发之前先听；发的时候一直听着，一听到冲突就马上停（冲突检测）。

items.en: **1 Gbps**: $10^9$ bits per second, so one bit takes 1 ns to send.
items.zh: **1 Gbps**：每秒 $10^9$ 位，所以发一位要 1 ns。

items.en: **1 km, no repeaters**: the two stations farthest apart are 1 km apart. **200,000 km/s** is how fast the signal travels along the cable, about two thirds of the speed of light.
items.zh: **1 公里，没有中继器**：相距最远的两个站隔 1 公里。**200,000 公里/秒**是信号沿电缆传播的速度，大约是光速的三分之二。

items.en: **Minimum frame size**: the shortest frame for which collision detection still works, in bits or bytes.
items.zh: **最小帧长**：冲突检测仍然有效的最短的帧，用位或字节表示。

title.en: Why a frame cannot be too short

text.en: A CSMA/CD sender learns of a collision only by hearing it **while it is still sending**. Once its last bit is out, it stops listening for collisions and assumes the frame got through. So the frame must last long enough for news of the worst collision to come back.
text.zh: CSMA/CD 的发送方只有**在还在发的时候**听到冲突，才知道撞了。最后一位发出去之后，它就不再监听冲突，认为这一帧成功了。所以帧必须持续得够久，久到最坏情况下冲突的消息能传回来。

alt.en: A space-time diagram with A on the left and B on the right, time going down. A starts at 0; its signal reaches B at τ. B starts just before τ, and the collision noise travels back, reaching A at 2τ. A bar beside A shows that A must still be sending at 2τ.
alt.zh: 时空图：A 在左，B 在右，时间向下。A 在 0 时刻开始发；信号在 τ 时刻到达 B。B 在 τ 之前一点点开始发，冲突的噪声往回走，在 2τ 时刻到达 A。A 旁边的条表示 A 到 2τ 时必须还在发。

caption.en: The worst case. A's first bit takes $\tau$ to reach B; B, hearing nothing yet, starts just before it arrives; the collision takes another $\tau$ to come back. A hears it at $2\tau$.
caption.zh: 最坏的情况。A 的第一位要 $\tau$ 才到 B；B 那时还什么都没听到，就在它到达前一刻开始发；冲突的噪声再走 $\tau$ 回来。A 在 $2\tau$ 时听到。

text.en: Here $\tau$ is the time a signal takes to cross the whole cable. The worst case puts the two stations at opposite ends: A starts; B, which cannot hear A yet, starts just before A's signal arrives; the collision happens at B's end, and its noise takes another $\tau$ to reach A. The course's slide: collisions can take as long as $2\tau$ to detect. So the frame's transmission time $T_f$ must be at least $2\tau$:
text.zh: 这里 $\tau$ 是信号走完整根电缆所需的时间。最坏情况是两个站在电缆两端：A 开始发；B 还听不到 A，就在 A 的信号到达前一刻也开始发；冲突发生在 B 那头，噪声还要再走 $\tau$ 才到 A。课件上说：检测到冲突最长可能要 $2\tau$。所以帧的发送时间 $T_f$ 至少要 $2\tau$：

text.en: where $B$ is the bandwidth: the shortest frame is the number of bits sent during one round trip along the cable.
text.zh: 其中 $B$ 是带宽：最短的帧，就是沿电缆跑一个来回的时间里发出的位数。

say.en: The time to cross the 1 km cable once.
say.zh: 信号走完 1 公里电缆一次的时间。

say.en: The worst-case time to hear a collision.
say.zh: 最坏情况下听到冲突所需的时间。

say.en: The frame must still be on the wire after $10\ \mu$s: at 1 Gbps that is 10 000 bits.
say.zh: $10\ \mu$s 之后帧还得在线上：1 Gbps 下就是 10 000 位。

outro.en: **Answer:** 10 000 bits, or 1250 bytes. Compare classic Ethernet's 64 bytes: at gigabit speed a frame is over before its first bit could cross a long cable and back.
outro.zh: **答案：**10 000 位，即 1250 字节。对比经典以太网的 64 字节：在千兆速度下，一帧还没等第一位在长电缆上跑个来回就发完了。

prompt.en: How many bits does a 1 Gbps sender put out in $10\ \mu$s?
prompt.zh: 1 Gbps 的发送方在 $10\ \mu$s 里发出多少位？

paras.en: For collision detection to work, a station must still be transmitting when news of a collision gets back to it, and in the worst case (stations at opposite ends) that takes the round-trip propagation time 2τ.
paras.zh: 冲突检测要起作用，冲突的消息传回来时，发送站必须还在发送；最坏情况下（两站位于两端），这需要往返传播时间 2τ。

paras.en: τ = 1 km / 200,000 km/s = 5 µs, so 2τ = 10 µs. At 1 Gbps, the minimum frame is 10 µs × 10⁹ bits/s = 10,000 bits = 1250 bytes.
paras.zh: τ = 1 km / 200,000 km/s = 5 µs，所以 2τ = 10 µs。1 Gbps 下，最小帧长为 10 µs × 10⁹ bit/s = 10,000 位 = 1250 字节。

text.en: The marks are in the rule ($2\tau$, and why) as much as in the number. The usual slip is to use one $\tau$, which gives 625 bytes.
text.zh: 分在规则上（$2\tau$ 以及为什么），和在数字上一样多。常见的错是只用一个 $\tau$，得出 625 字节。

title.en: Classic Ethernet, and why fast Ethernet is switched
title.zh: 经典以太网，以及快速以太网为什么用交换机

text.en: Classic Ethernet ran at 10 Mbps with a minimum frame of **64 bytes** (512 bits, $51.2\ \mu$s). A data field shorter than 46 bytes is padded up to it: that is the frame's pad field on the course's slide. After a collision a station waits a random number of these $51.2\ \mu$s slots, chosen from 0 to $2^i - 1$ after the $i$-th collision in a row: **binary exponential backoff**, which spreads the retries further apart the busier the cable is.
text.zh: 经典以太网的速率是 10 Mbps，最小帧长 **64 字节**（512 位，$51.2\ \mu$s）。数据部分不足 46 字节就补齐：这就是课件上帧格式里的填充字段。冲突之后，站等待随机个这样的 $51.2\ \mu$s 时隙，连续第 $i$ 次冲突后从 0 到 $2^i - 1$ 里随机选：这就是**二进制指数退避**，电缆越忙，重试就错得越开。

text.en: The course's efficiency formula shows the problem with going faster on one shared cable:
text.zh: 课件上的效率公式说明了在一根共享电缆上提速的难处：

text.en: with $B$ the bandwidth, $L$ the cable length, $c$ the signal speed and $F$ the frame length. A higher $B$ or a longer $L$, for the same frames, lowers the efficiency: more bits fit into each collision window, so each collision wastes more. That is why fast Ethernet is **switched**: each cable joins one computer to its own switch port, both directions can send at once, there is no shared channel and nothing to collide, and CSMA/CD is no longer needed.
text.zh: 其中 $B$ 是带宽，$L$ 是电缆长度，$c$ 是信号速度，$F$ 是帧长。帧长不变时，$B$ 越高或 $L$ 越长，效率越低：每个冲突窗口里装下的位更多，每次冲突浪费得也更多。这就是快速以太网用**交换机**的原因：每根电缆只把一台电脑接到交换机的一个端口，两个方向可以同时发，没有共享信道，也就没有冲突可言，CSMA/CD 也就用不上了。

prompt.en: A CSMA/CD network runs at 100 Mbps over a 200 m cable, with a signal speed of $2 \times 10^8$ m/s. What is the minimum frame size, in bits?
prompt.zh: 一个 CSMA/CD 网络运行在 100 Mbps，电缆长 200 米，信号速度 $2 \times 10^8$ m/s。最小帧长是多少位？

hints.en: Find $2\tau$ first, then multiply by the bandwidth.

title.en: Your turn: how far 64 bytes reach
title.zh: 你来：64 字节能跨多远

prompt.en: Classic Ethernet sends at 10 Mbps with a minimum frame of 64 bytes. With a signal speed of $2 \times 10^8$ m/s and nothing else slowing the signal, what is the longest cable on which collisions are always detected, in metres?
prompt.zh: 经典以太网以 10 Mbps 发送，最小帧长 64 字节。信号速度 $2 \times 10^8$ m/s，不计其他延迟，电缆最长多少米，冲突才总能被检测到？

explain.en: 512 bits at 10 Mbps last $51.2\ \mu$s $= 2\tau$, so $\tau = 25.6\ \mu$s and the cable is $25.6 \times 10^{-6} \times 2 \times 10^8 = 5120$ m. The standard allowed only 2500 m, because repeaters and transceivers add delay.
explain.zh: 512 位在 10 Mbps 下持续 $51.2\ \mu$s $= 2\tau$，所以 $\tau = 25.6\ \mu$s，电缆长 $25.6 \times 10^{-6} \times 2 \times 10^8 = 5120$ 米。标准只允许 2500 米，因为中继器和收发器还会增加延迟。

title.en: Your turn: a frame too short

prompt.en: On the problem's network, a station sends a 500-byte frame and it collides with a frame from the far end of the cable. What can happen?
prompt.zh: 在题目的网络上，一个站发了一个 500 字节的帧，和电缆另一头发来的帧撞上了。可能会怎样？

label.en: The sender finishes before the collision noise reaches it, assumes success, and the frame is lost without the MAC layer noticing
label.zh: 冲突噪声还没传回来，发送方就发完了，以为成功了；帧丢了，MAC 层却没察觉

label.en: The sender detects the collision after $\tau$ and resends
label.zh: 发送方在 $\tau$ 后检测到冲突，于是重发

feedback.en: Detection can take $2\tau$; a 500-byte frame lasts only $4\ \mu$s, less than $10\ \mu$s.
feedback.zh: 检测可能要 $2\tau$；500 字节的帧只持续 $4\ \mu$s，比 $10\ \mu$s 短。

label.en: Nothing: CSMA/CD listens before sending, so collisions cannot happen
label.zh: 没事：CSMA/CD 发之前先听，所以不会冲突

feedback.en: Listening first cannot hear a signal that has not arrived yet: the far station started before A's bits reached it.
feedback.zh: 先听也听不到还没传过来的信号：远端的站在 A 的位到达之前就开始发了。

explain.en: 500 bytes at 1 Gbps last $4\ \mu$s, but the noise may take $10\ \mu$s to return. The loss is left to a higher layer to discover.
explain.zh: 500 字节在 1 Gbps 下只持续 $4\ \mu$s，噪声却可能要 $10\ \mu$s 才回来。这个丢失只能留给上层去发现。
